ratings_why.fun: The last-gold choice and the drain turn are real climbing decisions, but the first four turns are thin and the late board is mostly +1/+1 piles.
ratings_why.distinct: Holding gold as a resource that pays every turn, against a town that pays for going broke, plays unlike any tribe today and unlike a stock auto-battler tribe.

verdict_why: No unit says which town it belongs to, so Old Messor, Maestro Tettix, Signora Afide and Madame Cigale can't be read as written.

points.text: No unit lists its town (Hive, Carnival or Road), yet Old Messor, Maestro Tettix, Signora Afide and Madame Cigale buff by town. Tag every unit.
Comb Guard is a plain 2/2 on turns 1 to 3, when you can't hold gold and still buy. Give it a flat bonus early, or let it count gold held at the start of the turn too, so it does its tempo job.
Bandstand Horn and Lantern Seller sit idle until you can spend 5 to 7 in one turn. A lower first step (say Fanfare 4) would let the Carnival start its direction at Tier 2.

A banked float never runs out, so Saint's Day trades away steady Reserve pay for one spike. Paying a bonus when the Purse refills after a drain would make the crossing loop the natural line rather than a rare one.
Winter Cluster's swap idea from the risks list would give the Hive a fight-side surprise beyond stats; worth trying in the next version.

standouts.why: Ottavia turns spend-versus-hold into one exact puzzle every turn, and the payoff is big enough to build for.
The Borrower is free money to a broke player and a placement puzzle for a saver; one card that splits the towns.
Madame Cigale makes the drain turn the loudest turn of the game, which is the fable paid out.

weakest.why: Comb Guard is a vanilla 2/2 in the turns a tempo body has to win.
Wax Sealer does nothing on a Carnival board and is a slow drip on a Hive one.
Signora Afide needs 16 gold handled in one turn to fire both halves; usually only one half fires.

flags.note: Mother Melissa with Old Messor on a 16-gold float gives +8/+8 to every Hive unit each turn for no ongoing cost.
Granary Clerk with Mother Melissa, golden, adds 8 gold a turn that feeds Messor, Gravelle and Ottavia; worth a runaway check.
Madame Cigale on a 20-gold drain turn gives +20/+20 to each Carnival unit, more with The Borrower each turn after.
Say plainly that gold beyond income means each gold spent after this turn's Spent passes income, whatever its source.
